shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git ls-files && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50
for f in index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore src/*; do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>&1; node -v; npm -v
npm view @gravity-ui/uikit version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20
npm view @gravity-ui/uikit@8.0.0 peerDependenciesMeta time.modified && npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -15
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat package.json | head -60 && sed -n 1,200p README.md && ls styles && ls build/esm/components | head -100
cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -150; echo ======; cat docs/migration-to-v8.md | head -250

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && sed -n 150,400p INDEX.md | grep -iE 'text|input|form|provider|theme|flex|box|checkbox|button|card|label|field' ; ls guides components components/controls 2>/dev/null
cat guides/migration-to-v8.md
sed -n 1,140p guides/theming.md
grep -nE '^#{1,3} ' guides/migration-to-v8.md | head -80
sed -n 39,106p guides/migration-to-v8.md; sed -n 469,530p guides/migration-to-v8.md; sed -n 650,760p guides/migration-to-v8.md
cat components/controls/TextInput.md components/controls/PasswordInput.md | grep -vE '^\s*$' | head -300

grep -vE '^\s*$' components/Checkbox.md | sed -n '/## Properties/,$p'; grep -vE '^\s*$' components/Button.md | sed -n '/## Properties/,/## CSS/p'; grep -nE 'variant|color' components/Text.md | head -30

grep -vE '^\s*$' components/Text.md | sed -n '/## Properties/,$p'; grep -vE '^\s*$' components/Card.md | sed -n '/## Properties/,$p' | head -30; grep -nE 'header-|subheader-|display-' guides/typography.md | head; grep -n 'as=' components/Text.md
grep -vE '^\s*$' guides/layout.md | sed -n 1,140p

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && ls components/layout; grep -vE '^\s*(\*|/\*\*)' components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -60; grep -nE 'padding|as\??:|maxWidth|width\??' components/layout/Box/*.d.ts components/layout/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; sed -n 1,80p components/Card/Card.d.ts | grep -vE '^\s*\*'
echo 'dist/' >> .gitignore && rm -rf dist; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npx --no-install playwright --version 2>&1 | head -1
npx vite-node --root /home/sandbox/workspace /tmp/smoke/render.tsx 2>&1 | head -30

cat > /tmp/smoke/vite.config.mjs <<'EOF'
export default { ssr: { noExternal: [/@gravity-ui/] } };
EOF
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx vite-node --root /home/sandbox/workspace --config /tmp/smoke/vite.config.mjs /tmp/smoke/render.tsx 2>&1 | grep -E '<(form|h1|label|input|button)|Войти|Запомнить|Error' | head -30
rm -rf /tmp/smoke; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && git status --short && git diff package.json .gitignore
